title: Partition equal subset sum
statement: Return whether the array can be split into two subsets with equal sums. n ≤ 200, values ≤ 100.
hints: Equivalently: is there a subset summing to total / 2?
reach[s] = some subset of the items so far sums to s. Iterate s downward so each item is used once.
complexity: O(n × sum) (or that divided by 64 with a bitset)

solution.explanation: 0/1 knapsack: for each item, reach[s] |= reach[s − x], with s iterating downward so the item isn't reused in the same round. Iterating upward gives the unbounded version, and that's a classic bug. A bitset (Python int or std::bitset) does a whole round as one shift-or: reach |= reach << x.
